snippet.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: Anchovy Feeding Frenzy! Gameplay
snippet.description:
This time I've decided to play an official SpongeBob game that was on the Nickelodeon website for some time. This is inarguably one of the first SpongeBob games ever made.

I was going to make an all-in-one video of all the Shockwave SpongeBob games, but due to OBS problems, the video was cut, resulting my plans to just upload one video per game. Considering how old it is, it's a Shockwave game. Not to be confused with Adobe Flash. It's pretty simple and quick to finish. I decided to purposely lose after my first gameplay to see what happens. It's not worth bragging over, though.

Nonetheless, I hope you enjoy this video! I'll be releasing other Shockwave SpongeBob games. Please consider liking and subbing, and have a great day!

Programs I've Used:
Flashpoint
OBS Studio
Paint.NET (for thumbnail)
